digest.component_or_area: test suite infrastructure / wiki render hardening
propositions: test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer executes a single monolithic loop over 884 renderable units with ~1768 serial pandoc spawns, costing 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding the 300s per-test timeout guard on the macOS py3.13 CI cell
pytest-timeout with --timeout-method=thread calls os._exit(1) from a timer thread, killing the xdist worker process without traceback when the per-test budget is exceeded
the test's unbounded cost causes intermittent worker crashes and Verified -1 markings on the macOS lane only, while ubuntu cells and other tests pass, demonstrating load-dependent failure

chunking the equivalence test into fixed-size batches of 40 units by parametrization bounds individual test cost to ~4.2s idle, preserving the byte-identity guarantee while enabling xdist work distribution
a new coverage guard test asserts that all chunks reassemble to the full corpus of 884 units to prevent silent unit dropout from chunking
